bamboo:G2.rhc: The camera is stuck to a single point and has a very narrow angle of rotation, making it impossible to orbit around the scene properly.

bamboo:11.rhc: The canopy looks like an image that's being stretched and back to mimic movement, no real 3D.

bamboo:12.rhc: The ground looks like uneven soil covered with dry bamboo leaves and small pebbles.

bamboo:13.mhc: The grove and fog continue in every direction, but they are finite. I can see a white-greenish background and the square where it's set when I zoom out.

bamboo:18.mhc: All stalks are the same shade of green and the only color variation is shadowing, without any yellowing or stains.

bamboo:19.rhc: Leaves do not read as translucent against the sky, they are just images with a white background.

bamboo:22.mhc: The canopy sways, and the movement looks natural.

lighthouse:G2.mhc: Yes, you can orbit around the lighthouse. The polar limit keeps the camera above the ground. But if you drag/pan the scene then you're able to go underground and outside the scene.

lighthouse:8.mhc: The tower is indeed octagonal, the lighting might make it seem a little rounded but its proportions match the photo.

lighthouse:18.mhc: I could notice a change in color on the rocks near the shoreline, as if they were wet. The snow reads as snow, and the rocks read as stone too.

lighthouse:29.mhc: The foam does not follow the water line on the shore, and it has a weird movement when the water is pulling away. The water limit also looks like a hard clip.

lighthouse:27.mhc: No visible tile pattern is present in the ocean.
